written.title: GTA 6 Reveals Massive, Dense Open World in 13 New Screenshots, Details
written.description: What Push Square, IGN, Eurogamer and GamesRadar+ reported about Jason Duval on 29 September 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Push Square, 29 September 2026

[GTA 6 Reveals Massive, Dense Open World in 13 New Screenshots, Details](https://www.pushsquare.com/news/2026/09/gta-6-reveals-massive-dense-open-world-in-13-new-screenshots-details)

The outlet's own summary:

> Regions! Wildlife! Activities

> We're getting through it 😄 6 4 Netret0120 2 hours ago This game is going to make $2 Billion in revenue on launch day alone 5 5 Max_the_German 2 hours ago None of these pictures gives me the feeling of “I want to be there and do things”.

> Jason and Lucia can also be seen chilling on the beach as someone with a USA flag runs by.

> There are also a handful of action-packed screenshots, as Lucia hides behind cover, Jason seemingly escapes a biker gang, and Jason again appears to have sneaked into a shop.

> The world map will have six regions: Vice City Leonida Keys Grassrivers Port Gelllhorn Ambrosia Mount Kalaga National Park Within those regions, you'll encounter 170 different types of wildlife, of which 60 are types of bird, another 30 are land mammals, and more.

> Activities by Liam Croft 3 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has shared more about the open world of Leonida you can explore in GTA 6 from 19th November 2026 by way of a new Game Informer magazine issue containing new screenshots and information.

> 5 9 NoCode23 2 hours ago Mount Kalaga National Park is definitely not in Florida, I wonder how it will fit in and be traveled to.

## IGN, 30 September 2026

[The Latest GTA 6 Screenshots Showcase Brand New Features, From Tropical Storms and Hunting to Big Butts Caught on Camera](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-everything-the-new-screenshots-tell-us)

The outlet's own summary:

> The latest GTA 6 screenshots showcase a bunch of great new features, from tropical storms and hunting, to simulated citrus farms and beach-ready butts.

> Game Informer’s cover story explains that the Ambrosia region of the map is home to a “local biker gang calling the shots”, and it very much looks like we’ll be butting heads with them – we can see Jason making a hasty getaway from a few armed gang members.

> This marks him as the club’s primary enforcer, and so there’s a good chance it’s this guy that Jason has pissed off.

> And since we know we can go to a tattoo parlor to get ink of our own, it’s likely that at least some of the designs we’ve seen can be applied to Jason and Lucia’s skin.

> Both Jason and Lucia are notably toned, likely as a result of heading to the gym, which can improve muscle definition.

> GTA 6 Side Activities View 24 Images Keeping Busy Talking of social media, that same beach screenshot shows both a sunbathing woman and Jason scrolling on their phone.

> Just remember, you can only scroll, not post yourself – as criminals, Jason and Lucia are looking to maintain a low profile.

> That same screenshot shows Jason and Lucia going for a run through the park, suggesting a couples 5k could be on the cards for casual dates.

> Hunting is a side activity in GTA 6, though, and we can see what looks like a more conventional version of it in the screenshot featuring Jason, a rifle, and a couple of deer.

> Jason’s rifle has also been kitted out with an autumnal woodland camo pattern.

> In the screenshot of Jason fleeing The Thirsty Wolf, we can even see two pigeons picking through trash, an indicator that each animal species may display recognisable real-world behaviour.

> There was surely absolutely no need for Rockstar to have created a simulated citrus farm (although if Jason and Lucia embark on a marmalade raid, I’ll eat my words).

> Similarly, a new screenshot shows Lucia holding an M4 assault rifle fitted with a silencer, red-dot scope, and forward grip – it seems like the weapon modification options will rival those seen in big first-person shooters.

> The First Chapter likely operates all over Ambrosia, but it seems like The Thirsty Wolf is one of their local hang outs.

> The magazine’s new cover story has revealed over 20 major new details , including how the world simulates tropical storms and some of the many animals that call Leonida home.

> First Chapter These new screenshots reintroduce us to the First Chapter, a Leonida motorcycle gang.

> Tucker’s is located on the Leonida-Gloriana line, GTA’s version of the Florida-Georgia line, and will likely play a part in creating an appropriate atmosphere for this more “country” area of Leonida.

> Just because we can’t post doesn’t mean we can’t take photos, though, and aside from the bizarre beach photo shoot, these new screenshots also show a man using an SLR-style camera in Mount Kalaga National Park.

> We already know that GTA 6 is set to feature the widest array of body types the series has ever had, and a new screenshot taken on Vice City’s beach showcases this perfectly.

> The two fellas in that same screenshot are holding out against some incoming alligators, which is a pretty unconventional way of hunting.

> We see a number of them across the new screenshots, including domestic dogs, alligators, buck and doe deers, ducks, and seagulls.

## IGN, 1 October 2026

[How Jason and Lucia's Character Designs Have Evolved Since the 2023 GTA 6 Trailer](https://www.ign.com/articles/how-gta-6s-jason-and-lucia-have-evolved-since-2023-in-pictures)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 officially releases next month, so we're taking a look at how the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, have evolved since their 2023 reveal.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 in Pictures Three years of evolution.

> By Cade Onder Updated : Oct 1, 2026 7:10pm UTC 2 comments Add IGN on Google GTA 6 officially releases next month, so we're taking a look at how the game's two protagonists, Jason and Lucia, have evolved since their 2023 reveal.

> GTA 6 appears to have only visually improved over time, and that is most evident in the level of detail on protagonists Jason and Lucia.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images Compared to the 2023 trailer, GTA 6's visuals have drastically changed.

> Jason only gets a few seconds to shine, but he largely looks like a generic white guy with his shaved head and stubble.

> Jason's brown hair flows out of the back of his hat.

> There's infinitely more customization options and Jason and Lucia are clearly at their final level of polish.

> In the first trailer, Lucia's skin looks less textured, more flat, and less nuanced.

> Both characters sport a variety of hairstyles, with Lucia rocking wavy hair and a golden dress.

> His skin glistens after sweating in the Vice City heat, his veins outline his arms, and his facial hair appears to be somewhat uneven, with certain strands of hair poking out slightly further than others.

> Watch Dogs, Cyberpunk 2077, and BioShock Infinite are all solid games, but they looked even better when they were initially revealed.

## Eurogamer, 2 October 2026

[GTA 6's 18+ PEGI age rating reveals Lucia and Jason can partake in drug use "directly from their inventory" and "at any time," alongside details on weapons](https://www.eurogamer.net/gta6-age-rating-pegi-lucia-jason-drug-use)

The outlet's own summary:

> Another age rating seems to reveal even more details from Rockstar's GTA 6: "Cocaine can be carried around by the player and snorted directly from their hand."

> GTA 6's 18+ age rating reveals Lucia and Jason can partake in drug use "directly from their inventory" and "at any time" Dealing details.

## GamesRadar+, 2 October 2026

[Here's everything new we learned about GTA 6 this week after Rockstar revealed new details on the animals, activities, and weather in its sprawling open-world sandbox](https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/heres-everything-new-we-learned-about-gta-6-this-week-after-rockstar-revealed-new-details-on-the-animals-activities-and-weather-in-its-sprawling-open-world-sandbox/)

The outlet's own summary:

> On this week's GTA 6 O'clock, James Jarvis and Dan Dawkins break down a huge batch of new GTA 6 details, including fresh information from Rob Nelson

> Every Friday GamesRadar+ Your weekly update on everything you could ever want to know about the games you already love, games we know you're going to love in the near future, and tales from the communities that surround them.

> There's plenty more covered in this week's episode of GTA 6 O'Clock, so you'll want to click the play button above to jump right into the conversation.

> Josh has contributed to world-leading gaming, entertainment, tech, music, and comics brands, including games™, Edge, Retro Gamer, SFX, 3D Artist, Metal Hammer, and Newsarama.

## IGN, 2 October 2026

[Brand New GTA 6 Screenshots Focus on Lucia and Jason's Relationship](https://www.ign.com/articles/brand-new-gta-6-screenshots-focus-on-lucia-and-jasons-relationship)

The outlet's own summary:

> Rockstar has further ramped up its GTA 6 marketing today with the launch of several new screenshots focusing on protagonists Lucia and Jason.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 Brand New GTA 6 Screenshots Focus on Lucia and Jason's Relationship Love to see it.

> By Tom Phillips Updated : Oct 2, 2026 3:59pm UTC 4 comments Add IGN on Google Rockstar has further ramped up its GTA 6 marketing today with the launch of several new screenshots focusing on protagonists Lucia and Jason.

> GTA 6's dynamic criminal duo can be seen in four new images published via Love Magazine , which features an illustration of the couple on its cover, and a black-and-white screenshot of the pair in more casual clothes (Jason in a white vest, jacked arms on show, Lucia in a leopard-print crop top).

> Two more images show Lucia and Jason together in the booth of a diner, but sat opposite.

> In Pictures: How GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Have Evolved Since 2023 View 13 Images Next up are images of Lucia and Jason in more stylish clothes (well, Jason is in bike leathers), and looking fierce while playing pool in what appears to be a biker bar.

> The one-night-only event, hosted live on ESPN, has been dubbed A Night in Vice City, and will see the home team donning an "all-new uniform on a never-before-seen court." We've got extensive coverage of GTA 6 across IGN.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
